name: Voxel Visibility Map Computation
definition: A method to determine which faces of solid voxels are visible by checking if adjacent voxels are transparent or out of bounds, producing a 3D map of visible face flags.
summary: Voxel Visibility Map Computation is a preprocessing step that produces a 3D map of visible face flags by explicitly computing per-voxel bitmasks rather than generating mesh primitives directly.
